children: Malaysia’s S&P Global Manufacturing PMI increased to 51 in October 2026 from 49.9 in September, which marked the first contraction in four months.
It was the strongest growth in factory activity since April, as output and new orders returned to growth.
Growth in new orders was solid and supported by a further improvement in overseas demand.

title: Malaysia Manufacturing PMI Rises to 6-Month High
